subject: Social Media
title: Bridge Nodes
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Bridge Nodes.

hook.text: A teenager shares K-pop in a gaming forum. Two unrelated communities collide. The meme explodes.

buildup.text: Bridge nodes exist in multiple communities at once. They carry content across social boundaries.

discovery.text: Content that crosses community boundaries reaches exponentially more people than content staying within one.

twist.text: Most content never crosses. It circulates within its origin community and fades. Bridges are rare and valuable.

climax.text: Brands pay influencers who straddle communities. A beauty guru who also games reaches two audiences.

punchline.text: Virality isn't about loudness. It's about bridges.

quiz.question: What is a 'bridge node' in a social network?
